user.title: Connect to Kestrel

error.invalid_auth: The plugin key was not accepted.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach the Kestrel plugin. Check the URL and that Scrypted is online.

abort.already_configured: This Kestrel plugin is already connected.

init.title: Kestrel settings
init.description: Choose how long Home Assistant waits for new plugin events before reconnecting. To get loud, clean bird-call previews, add the Kestrel audio service address and key; leave both empty to play BirdNET-Go's original recordings. Past calls from the last few days are sent to the service gradually; set the backfill to 0 to send only new calls. "Play reference" plays iNaturalist recordings; to use Xeno-canto's quality-rated songs and calls first, add your free Xeno-canto API key (on your account page at xeno-canto.org).

error.audio_incomplete: Enter both the audio service address (starting with http:// or https://) and its key, or leave both empty.
error.audio_cannot_connect: Could not reach the Kestrel audio service. Check the address and that the service is running.
error.audio_invalid_auth: The audio service key was not accepted.
error.xeno_canto_invalid_key: Xeno-canto did not accept this API key. Copy it again from your account page at xeno-canto.org.
error.xeno_canto_cannot_connect: Could not reach xeno-canto.org to check the key. Try again in a moment, or leave the field empty.
